description: Return every row whose rank is within the top 10, including all rows tied at the 10th place.

c.request: For each order reference (`orderexecutions.ordersmark`, with executions lacking a reference counted together as one group), count its execution records and compute its share of all execution records. What are the top 10 order references by how far their share is above the average share across order references? Show the order reference, execution count, share and share minus the average share, without rounding, from largest difference to smallest (missing values last). Return every row whose rank is within the top 10, including all rows tied at the 10th place.
c.sql:
WITH reference_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    execution_count,
    execution_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM reference_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    execution_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  ordersmark AS order_reference,
  execution_count,
  share,
  share_minus_average
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST;

b.request: For each distinct `orderexecutions.ordersmark` value, treating all NULL references as one group, count its execution records and calculate its share of all execution records. Compute the average of these group shares, then return every group whose rank by share minus the average is within the top 10, including all groups tied at rank 10. Show the order reference, execution count, share, and share minus average share, without rounding, ordered by difference descending with missing values last
b.sql:
WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
group_shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM group_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT ordersmark,
         execution_count,
         share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
  FROM group_shares
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST) AS share_rank
  FROM scored
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST

a.request: For each order reference (`orderexecutions.ordersmark`, with executions lacking a reference counted together as one group), count its execution records and compute its share: that count divided by the total number of execution records. Then compute the average share across order references. List the order reference, execution count, share, and share minus the average share, without rounding, sorted by that difference from largest to smallest (missing values last). Rank the rows by that difference, with tied rows sharing a rank and later ranks skipping accordingly, and return every row ranked 10th or better, so all rows tied at the 10th place are included even if that gives more than 10 rows.
a.sql:
WITH execution_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        COUNT(*) AS execution_count
    FROM orderexecutions
    GROUP BY ordersmark
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        execution_count,
        execution_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(execution_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM execution_counts
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        execution_count,
        share,
        share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference
    FROM shares
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ordersmark,
        execution_count,
        share,
        share_difference,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST) AS row_rank
    FROM scored
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_difference
FROM ranked
WHERE row_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_difference DESC NULLS LAST;

d.request: For each order reference in `orderexecutions.ordersmark` (group executions with no reference together), count the execution records and calculate each reference’s share of all execution records. Rank references by how far their share exceeds the average share across all references. Return every row tied within the top 10, showing the order reference, execution count, share, and share minus the average share without rounding, ordered from largest difference to smallest, with missing values last.
d.sql:
WITH reference_counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), shares AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count,
         execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM reference_counts
), ranked AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share - AVG(share) OVER () DESC NULLS LAST) AS difference_rank
  FROM shares
)
SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share_minus_average
FROM ranked
WHERE difference_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST;
